Name: Random Bundles
Author: balllight
Description:
[b][size=5]About[/size]
[/b]Feel bored with the changeless vanilla bundles? This mod randomizes all items of bundles in the community center. Download and be ready for a surprising game!

[b][size=5]How to start[/size]
[/b]1. Install SMAPI and this mod.
2. Install Generic Mod Config Menu.
3. Modify the settings in GMCM. You can choose the type of items which will be randomized and whether to use a specific seed.
4. Create a save and have fun.
(If you want to know the random seed of your save. Remember to check SAMPI console after the save was created.)

[b][size=5]Details[/size]
[/b]12 different types of items:
﻿"[b]Crops[/b]", "[b]Foraging[/b]", "[b]Fishing[/b]", "[b]Cooking[/b]", "[b]Minerals[/b]", "[b]Artifacts[/b]",
﻿"[b]Animal Product[/b]", "[b]Artisan Goods[/b]", "[b]Monster Loot[/b]", "[b]Resources[/b]", "[b]Crafting[/b]", "[b]Junk[/b]"
﻿(Detailed Lists will be post after a time.)
3 extra settings for randomizing:
﻿"[b]Vault[/b]" influences whether to randomize the cost of Vault Bundle.
﻿"[b]Desert[/b]" influences whether items from desert will be randomized.
﻿If you choose "[b]Guarantee Year 1 Completable[/b]" in Advanced Game Options. Items need year 2 won't be randomized.
Choose "[b]All Bundles Appear[/b]" to display all bundles as soon as you enter the community center.
Use random [b]seed[/b] to generate bundles. More than 4 billion possibilities wait to be explored.

[b][size=5]More[/size]
[/b]Please comment if you have any suggestion or problem!
Thanks to all the people who helped me during the development!
